## Claims
- [source-backed] \(\Lambda/I_{6,5}\) has Schur basis \(\{\bar s_\lambda:\lambda\subseteq5^6\}\), and multiplication is LR multiplication with terms outside \(5^6\) discarded. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-218; 263-269]
- [proved] With \(A_+:=\bigoplus_{e>0}A_e\) and \(\bar h_t=\bar s_{(t)}\), one has \(A_+=(\bar h_1,\ldots,\bar h_5)\).
- [proved] Put
  \[
  C_d=\{\mu:22\subseteq\mu\subseteq5^6,\ |\mu|=d\},\qquad
  R_d=\{(t,\lambda):1\le t\le5,\ 22\subseteq\lambda\subseteq5^6,\ |\lambda|=d-t\}.
  \]
  The row indexed by \((t,\lambda)\in R_d\), in the basis \(C_d\), is
  \[
  \bar h_t\bar s_\lambda
   =\sum_{\substack{\mu\in C_d\\\mu/\lambda\text{ horizontal }t\text{-strip}}}\bar s_\mu,
  \]
  and the lattice spanned by all these rows is exactly \((A_+J)_d\).
- [proved] \(R_d=\varnothing\) for \(d\le4\) (hence for \(d<4\)) and for \(d>35\). For every \(31\le d\le35\), \(R_d\ne\varnothing\), since \((d-30,5^6)\in R_d\), but every indexed row is the zero vector because \(C_d=\varnothing\).
- [unsupported] The supplied record identifies artifact `a3ad933b835c991bc8edccec918dce17c0e4594e4d1d4281e32946dd7e508ece` only as having been executed in degrees \(4,\ldots,30\); it supplies neither its degree-\(31,\ldots,35\) matrices nor its executable row-label data. Thus literal all-degree equality with that physical artifact’s indexed rows is not evidenced. [artifact 7407218a74525cf0e95adab0a2768940ab22d2e9faa3a3ddb10e5189643c306c, L1-L89]

## Strategy
Jacobi–Trudi gives \(\Lambda=\mathbb Z[h_1,h_2,\ldots]\). Since \(\bar h_t=\bar s_{(t)}=0\) for \(t>5\), every positive-degree element of \(A\) is a sum of positive monomials in \(\bar h_1,\ldots,\bar h_5\), hence lies in \((\bar h_1,\ldots,\bar h_5)\). The reverse inclusion is immediate.

LR containment implies that every nonzero term of \(\bar s_\alpha\bar s_\lambda\), for \(22\subseteq\lambda\), still contains \(22\). Hence \(J\) is an \(A\)-submodule and
\[
(A_+J)_d=\sum_{t=1}^5\ \sum_{\substack{22\subseteq\lambda\subseteq5^6\\|\lambda|=d-t}}
\mathbb Z\,\bar h_t\bar s_\lambda.
\]
For \(h_t=s_{(t)}\), the LR tableaux of content \((t)\) exist uniquely precisely when \(\mu/\lambda\) is a horizontal \(t\)-strip, giving the displayed row formula.

The possible sizes of \(\lambda\) are \(4,\ldots,30\); thus \(d=|\lambda|+t\) ranges from \(5\) through \(35\). If \(d>30\), then \(C_d=\varnothing\), so all existing rows are zero. In particular, omission of the nonempty zero-indexed families in degrees \(31,\ldots,35\) preserves the row lattice \(0=(A_+J)_d\), but does **not** preserve equality of indexed row families.

## Gaps
The mathematical complete-row presentation and all boundary classifications are proved. The requested literal assertion that these are the physical artifact’s rows “in every degree” is not established from the supplied record: degrees \(31,\ldots,35\) require retained zero rows, while the identified execution is recorded only through degree \(30\).

## Next
A degree-\(4,\ldots,35\) artifact retaining the labels \(R_d\), including zero rows for \(31\le d\le35\), is required to establish literal indexed-row equality.
